We're mercenaries—and there's no more profit in this fight."''
"''If you abandon your posts I will hunt you down and kill you myself!|Fife and Rook Kast|}} '''Rook Kast''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Mandalorian]] [[Soldier|warrior]] who led the [[Shadow Collective]]'s [[Mandalorian super commando|super commandos]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. After [[Maul]], leader of the Shadow Collective, was [[Prison|imprisoned]] by the [[Sith]] on [[Stygeon Prime]], Kast and [[commando]] [[Gar Saxon]] [[Escape from the Spire|freed]] Maul and brought him to a [[Zanbar Death Watch camp|Shadow Collective base]] on [[Zanbar]]. They were tracked by the [[Confederacy military|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and, in the [[Battle of Zanbar|ensuing battle]], forced to flee to [[Ord Mantell]]. From there, they repelled a Separatist [[Battle on Ord Mantell|attack]]. Kast and Maul captured the [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] in [[orbit]], while Maul's ground forces captured the Separatist [[Head of State|leader]], [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. The Shadow Collective took their [[prisoner]]s to a [[Vizsla Keep 09|Mandalorian asteroid base]], which was assaulted by the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order]] in an attempt to capture Dooku themselves. Kast, Maul, Dooku, and some of Maul's forces fled and set a course for [[Dathomir]]. They were tracked by [[Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]], who fought alongside Dooku and Grievous in destroying the Shadow Collective forces. Kast recovered Maul from the [[Second Battle of Dathomir|battle]], and they fled the [[planet]]. Later, Kast participated in the [[Siege of Mandalore]] and helped lure an unsuspecting [[Ahsoka Tano]] into the [[undercity]] of [[Sundari]]. There, she and several other super commandos surrounded the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] for Maul, but she eventually managed to escape. Shortly afterwards, the super commandos managed to capture [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC Trooper]] [[Jesse]] and interrogate him. After his interrogation, Maul managed to rally the Mandalorians for one last push, but this led to defeat and Kast's capture at the hands of [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]. ==Biography== ===Rescuing Maul=== {{Quote|More droids coming this way. They're still down the corridor.|Rook Kast sights incoming battle droids within the Spire|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Mandalore]], Rook Kast was the leader of the [[Mandalorian super commando]]s—Mandalorian [[soldier]]s who served the [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]]{{TCW|The Lawless}} and were a part of his criminal alliance, the [[Shadow Collective]], during the [[Clone Wars]].{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}} [[File:Kast_Shoots_Zipline.png|thumb|left|225px|Kast fires a zipline out of the Spire.]] In the [[Standard year|year]] [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' after Maul was [[Battle of Mandalore|bested]] in [[Lightsaber combat|combat]] by his former [[Sith Master|master]], [[Darth Sidious]], he was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] in the [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)|Spire]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[prison]] on the planet [[Stygeon Prime]]. Kast and [[Commander]] [[Gar Saxon]] followed Sidious and Maul to Stygeon, and were tasked by Mandalorian [[Prime Minister]] [[Almec]], whom Maul had selected as the public leader of Mandalore after his [[Takeover of Mandalore|takeover]] of the planet,{{TCW|Shades of Reason}} with infiltrating the Spire and [[Escape from the Spire|rescuing]] Maul. Kast and Saxon dispatched two [[BX-series droid commando|commando droids]] on the balcony of the prison's third level before updating the Prime Minister on their progress. After setting charges on the balcony entrance, the pair entered the prison and made their way to level seven, where Maul was being held. As they approached his cell, they encountered a quartet of [[droideka]]s and several [[B2-series super battle droid]]s, but managed to deactivate the super [[battle droid]]s and fire a [[missile]] at the droidekas, clearing the way to Maul's cell. Once Maul was freed, the two Mandalorians blew a hole in the prison wall and shot a zipline out towards their [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|Gauntlet fighter]], allowing the three to escape the planet and return to a [[Zanbar Death Watch camp|Shadow Collective base]] on the [[moon]] of [[Zanbar]]. However, they were unaware that the Separatists had tracked them back to their base. [[File:Maul_returns_to_Nightbrother.png|thumb|250px|Kast picks Maul up in the ''Nightbrother'' following his duel with Grievous.]] Sighting several incoming [[C-9979 landing craft]]s in Zanbar's [[atmosphere]], Kast informed Maul that [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] had arrived. The [[Zabrak]] ordered his [[troop]]s to engage the [[Separatist Droid Army]], resulting in a [[Battle of Zanbar|battle]] which saw heavy losses for both factions. As the battle neared its end, Maul engaged [[General]] [[Grievous]], [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|leader]] of the [[Droid]] [[Army]], in a [[lightsaber duel]]. Kast, aboard Maul's Gauntlet [[Starfighter|fighter]], the [[Nightbrother (Gauntlet fighter)|''Nightbrother'']],{{Databank|the-nightbrother|The Nightbrother}} ordered the [[pilot]] to lower the [[Starship|ship]] closer to Maul, allowing him to jump on board. Maul ordered Kast to take them away from the moon, and the remaining troops at Zanbar regrouped with the larger Shadow Collective force and traveled to a [[Black Sun]] base on [[Ord Mantell]]. ===Battle at Ord Mantell=== {{Quote|There! As soon as we're underneath their firing range—attach to their ship!|Maul to Rook Kast, as the two prepare to board Grievous's command ship|}} [[File:Kast_pilots_Gauntlet.png|thumb|left|250px|Kast and Maul take the ''Nightbrother'' to Grievous's command ship.]] In [[Ord Mantell City]], Kast attended a meeting with Maul, Saxon, Black Sun leader [[Ziton Moj]], and [[Pyke Syndicate]] [[majordomo]]''[[Dark Disciple]]'' [[Fife]]. Maul, knowing that Separatist [[Head of State|leader]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]], Grievous, and the Droid Army would be coming for them, laid out a plan for the other four on how to deal with the incoming Confederate forces. After receiving word that a [[shuttle]] from [[Dathomir]] had arrived, which was carrying [[Nightbrothers]] to aid the Shadow Collective, Maul and Saxon left to greet the shuttle, while Maul ordered Kast to inform the others of his plan. The Separatists forces soon arrived, [[Orbital bombardment|bombarding]] the [[city]] from [[Realspace|space]] before landing their own troops. As the Mandalorians, Black Sun, and [[Pyke]]s [[Battle on Ord Mantell|engaged]] the Separatists on the planet surface, Maul and Kast took the ''Nightbrother'' into Ord Mantell's [[orbit]] and boarded Grievous's [[command ship]]. Maul stormed the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|ship's]] [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and threatened to [[Death|kill]] Grievous if he did not shut down the Separatist droids. Grievous complied, leading to a swift Shadow Collective victory which saw the capture of Grievous as well as Dooku, who had been battling the Nightbrothers on the surface of Ord Mantell. ===Assault on Vizsla Keep 09=== {{Quote|We've been boarded-- two ''Jedi'' have been spotted in hangar three.|Kast informs Maul of the arrival of the Jedi|[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]]}} [[File:Kast_missile.png|thumb|200px|Kast fires a missile at the Jedi.]] The Shadow Collective took their captives back to [[Vizsla Keep 09]],{{Databank|vizsla-keep-09|Vizsla Keep 09}} a Mandalorian supply outpost hidden in the [[Asteroid field|rings]] of [[Phelbos]], and Maul contacted his old master, Sidious, informing him of their capture. Maul ordered Kast to lock Grievous away in the outpost's brig while he spoke with Dooku. A [[Galactic Republic]] task force, led by [[Jedi General]]s [[Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Tiplee]], and [[Aayla Secura]], soon arrived at the Keep and began to [[Assault on Vizsla Keep 09|battle]] with the Mandalorian forces. Kast informed Maul that the [[Jedi]] had arrived in the third [[hangar]], prompting Dooku to temporarily ally himself with Maul. The two [[Sith]] began dueling the Jedi, quickly leading to the death of [[Jedi Master|Master]] Tiplee. Kast fired a missile at the Jedi, rendering both Secura and Windu unconscious. Maul, Dooku, Kast, and Saxon retreated from the outpost aboard the ''Nightbrother'' and traveled to Dathomir. ===Defeat on Dathomir=== {{Quote|Lord Maul! Dathomir is lost! We must retreat!|Rook Kast, to Maul|}} Shortly before entering Dathomir's atmosphere, Maul—revealing to Dooku that he knew the count still remained loyal to Sidious and did not truly wish to ally himself with Maul—had Kast hold her [[blaster]] to Dooku's head and watch his every move as their ship landed at the [[Nightbrother village]], where they disembarked. Kast handed Dooku over to the Nightbrothers, who brought him and Maul to a chamber in the village which was said to be the heart of the power of [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]], a [[Dathomirian]] [[witch]] who had once{{TCW|Massacre}} led the [[Nightsisters]]{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}} and was the [[Parent|mother]] of Maul. As Talzin drained Dooku's life force so that she could take physical form once again, Sidious and Grievous arrived on Dathomir aboard a [[Cloaking device|cloaked]] [[Scimitar|ship]] and entered the chamber. The [[cyborg]] general and [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Dark Lord]] [[Second Battle of Dathomir|engaged]] Maul and the Talzin-[[Possession|possessed]] Dooku in [[lightsaber]] combat as Kast, on board the ''Nightbrother'', communicated with Ziton Moj and Fife as their forces were bombarded by a Separatist assault. Kast ordered the two to follow their orders and fight, however they threatened to withdraw from the Shadow Collective if they did not receive support. After losing many of their own ships and not receiving assistance, Black Sun and the Pykes informed Kast that they would no longer support the Collective. Kast protested, threatening to track them down and kill them herself, however Moj and Fife remained unfazed, and ended their transmission. [[File:KastMojFifeHolo-SoD-4.png|thumb|left|250px|Kast confers with Moj and Fife.]] A [[commando]] informed Kast that a Separatist invasion [[fleet]] was approaching the planet, and the two flew to Maul's location and told him they needed to evacuate at once. Talzin, who had managed to regain her physical form, held off a barrage of [[Force lightning]] from Sidious and Dooku, who had regained control of his body, and told her son to leave without her. Maul refused, however the witch threw him back towards the ''Nightbrother'' so that he may escape. Despite Maul's protests, Kast and the other commando grabbed hold of Maul and pulled him up the ship's ramp. Maul cried out in anguish as he watched Grievous step forward and stab Talzin with his lightsabers, killing her. Maul, Kast, and the commando boarded the ''Nightbrother'' and fled the planet just as the Separatists landed their forces on Dathomir, ravaging the Nightbrother village. ===Siege of Mandalore=== ====Fighting the Republic invasion==== {{Quote|The Jedi was sighted entering the lower city.''"
"''Then it's just as our Lord predicted.|Rook Kast and Almec|audio=RookKastAlmec.flac|}} [[File:GarSaxonRookKast-OFNF.png|thumb|285px|Maul's forces prepare for the Siege of Mandalore.]] Eventually, Kast and the rest of the super commandos regrouped on Mandalore within the domed city of [[Sundari]]. During the last days of the Clone Wars, the [[Mandalore resistance]] and the Galactic Republic launched a joint [[Siege of Mandalore|invasion]] of Mandalore. After ending a transmission with the invaders, Almec tasked Kast with contacting the rest of the Collective, which had been reformed, and informing them about the invasion.{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} Later, she ventured into the [[undercity]] of Sundari as part of a trap to lure out the former Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]]. Gar Saxon and several other super commandos lured Republic forces down into the sewage ports and, as they explored, Kast contacted Almec to inform him of the plan's continued success before they were cutoff by an invasion of the royal palace. As the Republic forces ventured deeper into the undercity, Kast waited with her forces to ambush them. Eventually, Kast emerged from hiding and fired an explosive at the Republic forces, disorienting them and luring them out to be killed by her and the rest of the super commandos. After effortlessly eliminating the [[clone trooper]]s in the undercity, the super commandos surrounded Tano as Maul emerged from hiding to confront her. As Kast and the other Mandalorians continued to train their weapons on Tano, Maul walked out and spoke with the former Jedi. As they talked, Tano clicked a button on her [[wrist comm]], calling her forces to her position. As they arrived, the Mandalorians entered a firefight with the clones as Maul and Tano crossed sabers. Knowing it wasn't [[time]] for a confrontation, Maul left along with Kast and the surviving Mandalorians. Tano and the clones continued to chase them through the undercity but the Mandalorians managed to throw the clones off their trail, disappearing deeper into the tunnels.{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}} ====Counterattacks==== {{Quote|The dark side has never been stronger.''"
"''My Lord, what does it mean?|Maul and Rook Kast|audio=MaulRook-TPA.flac|}} [[File:MaulStripMinding-TPA.png|thumb|left|275px|Maul forcibly extracted information from Jesse's mind, while Rook Kast held him in position.]] In a counterattack, the Mandalorians ambushed the clones on their way fortify [[C-deck]], leading to the capture of [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC Trooper]] [[Jesse]]. Being brought before Maul, Jesse was kept in [[stuncuffs]] and held in place by Kast. As Jesse told Maul that he would not tell him anything, Maul made sure he knew the contrary was true as Kast began to smile. As Jesse continued to squirm, Maul [[Mind probe|probed]] his mind using [[the Force]], searching for information on who Ahsoka Tano was. Kast held him in place as Jesse began to scream in agony. After Jesse's interrogation, Maul contacted the leaders of the syndicates within the Shadow Collective, telling them to go into hiding. As Saxon returned from his mission to assassinate Almec (who had been in Republic custody after he was captured during an attack on the [[Grand Salon|throne room]]), Kast informed him of this fact. As Maul reminded Kast and Saxon of their help in liberating him from the Spire on Stygeon Prime, he turned towards them and informed them of him and Dooku's purpose in Sidious' grand plan. Kast then asked Maul what this meant, to which Maul informed all of the Mandalorians present that the galaxy would soon be controlled by another power and that they would thrive in the chaos. He promised them that if they were to perish, they would die on the battlefield, as warriors, rallying the Mandalorians for one last attack against the Mandalorian resistance and Republic. [[File:RookKast-SWL94.png|thumb|right|275px|Rook Kast leading the Mandalorians in a final push during the Siege of Mandalore.]] In one last counterattack, Kast and Saxon led a charge against the joint Mandalorian resistance and Republic forces while they attempted to move civilians to safe zones. As the two sides charged towards one another, Kast fired her blasters into the crowd of troopers, eventually coming face to face with several and killing each of them with ease. However, reinforcements from the Mandalorian resistance eventually arrived. With them arrived [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], their leader, who entered into [[Unarmed combat|hand-to-hand combat]] with Kast before the Mandalorians were forced to surrender due to the overwhelming numbers of the Mandalorian resistance and Republic together. Maul then abandoned the Mandalorians as he attempted to escape but was captured by Republic forces after losing his duel with Tano. ===Legacy=== A picture of Kast as part of the Shadow Collective was in "[[Index of Organizations]]," a survival compendium sent out by [[Carson Teva]] during the [[New Republic Era]].{{GermanFanCite|115|Database}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Lord Maul—I was afraid we'd lost you.|Rook Kast, to Maul|}} [[File:RookKastFull-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|left|200px|Rook Kast]] Rook Kast was intensely loyal to the Shadow Collective cause and to Maul, to the point she became one of the first Super Commandos to swear loyalty to the former Sith and donned his colors on her armor, embracing her warrior heritage. She personally went to evacuate Maul on multiple occasions and showed concern for his safety as he faced Grievous on Zanbar and even forcibly attempted to bring Maul onto his ship on Dathomir before the Separatists landed their troops and laid waste to the world. When Black Sun and the Pykes announced to Kast that they would no longer aid the Collective, Kast was quick to make the threat that she would go after them and kill them herself should they desert. Though some Mandalorians, such as Bo-Katan Kryze and many of her [[Nite Owls]], refused to accept Maul as the leader of Mandalore due to him being an outsider—despite besting the previous [[Mandalore (title)|leader]], [[Pre Vizsla]], in combat—Maul's non-Mandalorian heritage did not present an issue for Kast, and she faithfully served him regardless. Kast was a female member of the human [[species]], who stood at 1.7 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|feet]], 7 inches) tall. She had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and fair skin. By the time of the Siege of Mandalore, Kast had purple hair. ==Skills and abilities== Kast was a ferocious warrior on the battlefield. She knew how to operate blasters and a [[jetpack]] with extreme efficiency, more so than that of her fellow soldiers. She was also known for her strategic awareness. Kast was proficient in hand-to-hand combat as well, holding off clones and a few members of the Mandalore resistance in a fistfight, before Bo-Katan Kryze overpowered her and forced her to surrender to the Republic's forces. ==Equipment== Like all Mandalorian soldiers, Kast wore [[Mandalorian armor]] over a black [[body glove]], as well as a jetpack, which could be used to launch missiles. Around each of her [[Limb|forearms]] was a [[Mandalorian vambrace]], which contained a zipline. Kast's [[armor]], like most Mandalorian super commandos, was painted red and black, meant to resemble Maul's appearance,{{Databank|mandalorian-super-commando|Mandalorian Super Commando}} and featured the Shadow Collective's black hand symbol on her right shoulder pad. Kast's helmet was different from most traditional Mandalorian helmets however, featuring two pointed slopes atop it. During the Siege of Mandalore, Kast utilized two [[WESTAR-35 blaster pistol]]s. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Rook_Kast_no_helm.png|thumb|right|120px|Rook Kast made her first appearance in ''Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir''.]] Rook Kast first appeared in [[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir|''Star Wars: Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir'']], a four-part [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries written by [[Jeremy Barlow]] with art by [[Juan Frigeri]]{{DarkHorse|url=Books/24-771/Star-Wars-Darth-Maul-Son-of-Dathomir-TPB|text=title=''Star Wars: Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir'' trade paperback}} that ran from [[May]]{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/24-765/Star-Wars-Darth-Maul-Son-of-Dathomir-1|text=title=''Star Wars: Darth Maul–Son of Dathomir #1''}} to [[August]] in [[2014]]{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/24-768/Star-Wars-Darth-Maul-Son-of-Dathomir-4|text=Star Wars: Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir #4}} and was adapted from unfinished episodes of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.{{Facebook|username=DaveFiloni|url=DaveFiloni/posts/10152103755565053|name=[[Dave Filoni]]|date=January 10, 2014|archivedate=20190804073349}} Prior to the release of ''Son of Dathomir'', Kast was first mentioned in the "[[Blaster (department)|Blaster]]" section of [[Star Wars Insider 149|''Star Wars Insider'' 149]],{{InsiderCite|149|Blaster}} released on [[April 22]], 2014,{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/149|text=Star Wars Insider #149}} as one of the new things fans could expect to see in ''Son of Dathomir''.{{InsiderCite|149|Blaster}} [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] creative executive{{SWYouTube|lNVfsIkLm0M|Pablo Hidalgo and Leland Chee Interview with StarWars.com | Star Wars Celebration Anaheim|sw_url=video/pablo-hidalgo-and-leland-chee-interview-star-wars-celebration-anaheim}} [[Pablo Hidalgo]] stated on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that Rook Kast was one of a few elements that inspired the design of the{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/766721204463898624|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=She was not; it was a Nite Owl + Rook Kast + original paint scheme + secret sauce|archivefile=File:Sabine design inspiration.png}} ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' character{{SWYouTube|-_0A2-YDexw|Meet Sabine, the Explosive Artist | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-meet-sabine-the-explosive-artist}} [[Sabine Wren]]. Kast later appeared in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh season]] of ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'', released in [[2020]],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-returns-on-disney-february-21|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Returns on Disney+ February 21}} where she was voiced by [[Vanessa Marshall]].
